messages:
Nina (PM): Quick poll  for the usage table: should invoice download live on the row or only in the expanded detail? Customers confused when CSV and invoice actions are separate.

Omar (Design): My take: keep a subtle per-row invoice icon for quick access, but put full invoice details + breakdown in the expanded panel. That reduces clicks for common case while keeping details discoverable.

Priya (Frontend): Agree. Implementation note: we should lazy-load invoice URL when the row is focused or the icon is hovered >150ms to avoid extra network on list render. Also, icon needs a tooltip and focus target.

Ben (Accessibility): If icon is actionable, it must have a clear aria-label like "Download invoice for Project A (Feb 2026)" and be in tab order. Avoid using only color to indicate invoice availability.

Hao (Backend): We can add invoice_available boolean to the list endpoint. For the quick-download link, we'll return a signed URL TTL 1hr. Consolidated invoices will remain an async job.

Priya (Frontend): Microcopy suggestion for the header: change "Tokens used" -> "API tokens (30d)" and add a question-mark tooltip that explains rounding and aggregation window.

Nina (PM): Decision: quick icon + expanded detail, lazy-load URLs on focus/hover, update header microcopy. Omar/Priya: please land a spec by EOD. Ben: will run quick a11y checklist post-PR.

NotifyBot: Reminder: Design review tomorrow 10am.
